name: SYD1 Ultimo expansion (ex-Global Switch Sydney East/West)

address.value: 390-422 Harris Street and 273 Pyrmont Street, Ultimo NSW
address.note: master.csv gives 392-422 Harris St; SSD documents use 390-422

postcode.note: Ultimo postcode (Australia Post); ESD report gives site address

lat.note: Geocoded from street address via NSW Spatial Services address point for 390-422 HARRIS STREET ULTIMO (273 Pyrmont St is at -33.87536,151.19802). Address point, not building centroid; campus spans a larger lot.

builder.note: DGT ASX release 15 Oct 2026 (source 15): 'Shape Australia Pty Ltd has been appointed as head contractor for the SYD1 Expansion on a fixed price lump sum Design & Construct Contract'; Laing O'Rourke 'continues as integrated delivery partner'. SHAPE Australia Pty Ltd gave the Condition A9(a) notice of commencement 'acting on behalf of the Applicant (HDI SYD1 Property Holdings Limited)', with SHAPE project office and construction manager on site. SHAPE's '20MW Upgrade at DigiCo SYD1' (source 6, snippet) may be earlier densification works

developer.note: applicant HDI SYD1 Property Holdings Limited (DigiCo); HMC Capital-managed REIT

mw_it.note: EIS: 'Increase in the total power consumption capacity from 42.5MW to 88 MW (45.5MW increase)' and 'will operate as an 88MW (IT load) data centre'. The consent/portal description says 'increase in power consumption of 47.5 megawatts (MW)' (source 11); DCD/master.csv give +47.5 MW (West +24.5, East +23). Site total after expansion 88 MW IT. DGT (15 Oct 2026, source 15) calls it the 'SYD1 52MW capacity expansion' and says SYD1 is '100% contracted across 88MW of total capacity' (71MW contract with a global technology firm)

mw_grid.note: AR: 'Total power consumption of 120 MW (88 MW IT load)' - whole site after expansion, not the increment

cost_aud_m.note: estimated development cost $605,593,980 (excl. GST; WT Partnership EDC report 8 Apr 2025, source 14, and AR). EDC under PS 24-002, which replaced CIV for SSD thresholds

authority.note: City of Sydney LGA; determined by Executive Director

lodged.note: application form filed on portal 10 Apr 2025 ('Application_20250410'); EIS uploaded 30 Apr 2025; exhibited 2 May - 29 May 2025. Exact lodgement date not stated in AR. SEARs issued May 2024

determined.note: portal Determination Date 23/12/2025 (Executive Director); DigiCo ASX release 29 Dec 2025

jobs_construction.note: AR: '80 full-time equivalent construction jobs'; EIS: 'approximately 80 full time equivalent (FTE) construction jobs over a two (2) - three (3) year construction period' and 'direct employment, including 80 construction jobs'. Not stated whether peak or average

jobs_operational.note: AR: 'retention of 45 operational jobs'; EIS: 'ongoing retention of 45 direct operational jobs' - retained existing jobs, not new

construction_start.note: planned: SHAPE notice (7 Sep 2026) says the construction phase 'is scheduled to physically commence on 7 October 2026' (two added storeys, column jacketing, upgrade to 88MW). AR: construction over 21 months. DPHI approved the CEMP (Shape, Rev 3) on 12 Nov 2026 (source 16); the CEMP is a pre-construction requirement, so physical SSD construction may have started later than 7 Oct 2026

construction_end.note: DGT 15 Oct 2026 (source 15): 'The first 10MW of the SYD1 Expansion is expected to be energised and income producing in late Q4 FY27, with the balance delivered progressively over FY28'. expected; delivered in phases across FY27-FY28 (i.e. by June 2028), first 10 MW by end FY27 per FY26 results (source 5, snippet only, kalkine 403). AR gives a 21-month construction period

open_questions: mw_it increment: EIS states 45.5 MW IT increase (42.5 to 88 MW); consent/portal description says 47.5 MW 'power consumption' increase - both in primary documents; 45.5 kept as IT
relationship of SHAPE's '20MW Upgrade at DigiCo SYD1' (due June 2026, snippet) to the SSD works unclear
mw: DGT now calls the expansion 52MW (site 88MW total) vs 45.5MW IT (EIS) / 47.5MW (consent); construction end FY28 per DGT 15 Oct 2026
construction start: planned 7 Oct 2026 but CEMP only approved 12 Nov 2026
